errors.fix: Put text in quotes or create the variable first.

errors.fix: Use round(x, 2) for display or Decimal for money.

errors.why: ** groups right to left, so this is 2 ** 9 = 512, not 64. A silent logic surprise.
errors.fix: Add brackets to make your intent clear: (2 ** 3) ** 2.

errors.why: Same-level operators run left to right: (7 / 2) * 2 = 7.0. Usually fine, but check your intent.
errors.fix: Use brackets when unsure.
